resources.string: Pay without internet. Scan, then follow the *99# steps.
UPI ID or pasted UPI link
Enter a valid amount first (up to 2 decimals).

1. Tap Open *99# below. The dialer opens; press call.
2. Pick Send Money, then UPI ID.
3. Paste the UPI ID, enter the amount, add a remark if asked.
4. Enter your UPI PIN to confirm.

Menu wording can differ slightly by bank.
No dialer app found on this device.
Camera permission is needed to scan QR codes.
